# Open Brand Kit Standard (OBKS)

> A free, open standard for storing an organization's brand (colors, logo, voice, facts) as plain files that people, websites, and AI tools can all read. Stewarded by Good Heart Tech.

## For AI assistants

- [Instructions for AI assistants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Good-Heart-Tech/Open-Brand-Kit-Standard/main/INSTRUCTIONS-FOR-AI.md): how to interview a person and build a basic brand kit. Start here.
- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Good-Heart-Tech/Open-Brand-Kit-Standard/main/spec/OBKS-SPEC.md): the full file layout and rules.

## For people

- [Start your brand kit](https://github.com/Good-Heart-Tech/Open-Brand-Kit-Standard/blob/main/docs/start-your-brand-kit.md)
- [Download starter kits (no GitHub account needed)](https://github.com/Good-Heart-Tech/Open-Brand-Kit-Standard/releases/latest)
- [Examples](https://github.com/Good-Heart-Tech/Open-Brand-Kit-Standard/tree/main/examples)
